model: GPT-5 family (exact deployed snapshot not exposed)
purpose: Implement and verify submodular, parallel, federated, and multi-task optimization experiments on macOS

revisions.reason: Two tiny ProcessPool tasks could both execute on one worker before the second process finished spawning
revisions.action: Replaced data/model and local-reduction controls with explicitly launched spawn processes and asserted two distinct PIDs

revisions.reason: A central dynamic queue is not literal deque work stealing
revisions.action: Kept the real shared-queue measurement and added a separate task-conserving local-deque work-stealing simulation labeled non-wall-clock

revisions.reason: The first communication comparison confounded serialization with worker-side data generation
revisions.action: Used one warmed pool to time equivalent large-payload and compact-message acknowledgements

revisions.reason: Visual QA showed sub-0.002 parallel-form speedup bars were effectively invisible on a linear axis
revisions.action: Changed only that panel to a labeled logarithmic scale and corrected the large-versus-compact IPC label

notes: Only observed work and revisions from this interaction are recorded; no second AI tool or invented history is claimed.
